Release: held-mark refresh waits out the venue's 429 hold inside its run budget and records pushed books at the SLA (int-wave1 32321e0) [deploy-approved]

Production evidence (research-sql 37384642567): 21 refresh runs, 0-1 of 90
reads OK each; 158 of 463 dispatches rate-limited (Retry-After 7-10 s); the
gate refused 1,405 reads whose 8 s deadline could not outlast the hold.

The refresh now sleeps a hold <= 15 s inside its own 45 s budget, stops the
REST lane on a longer hold (every remaining due market recorded
SKIPPED_VENUE_COOLDOWN, FEED_GAP), and records an eligible pushed book with its
own receipt instant when the market-data subscription runs in this process.
SLA (300 s), classifier, allocation rail and every risk gate unchanged.
Paper only; no order path.

Release hotfix: Derek's PAPER entries obey the existing same-contract rule [deploy-approved]

525bc44 + one fix (tree of claude/inc-release-full @ 93254f2). In production
on 525bc44, after migration 264 re-enabled Derek's PAPER entries, Derek's
ENTRY orders named no strategy: each row took the column default
(DEREK_ENTRY_POLICY_V2) while the same-contract check under the account lock
received None and found nothing held, so the existing rule "a strategy does
not re-enter the exact contract and side it already holds" never applied to
Derek (one contract was entered 15 times in 22 minutes, PAPER only).

The ledger now checks an unnamed order under the strategy its row carries,
and Derek's order names its strategy. No limit, threshold, cap, sizing or
policy parameter changes; no live, SMALL LIVE or funded control is touched;
SMALL LIVE stays SHADOW. PAPER only; no order is placed or cancelled by this
release. API and workers deploy this exact commit.
